text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting solid gains with ETH outpacing BTC, suggesting confidence has broadened beyond the largest asset into established alts. The Fear & Greed index at 71 and rising sharply over the week indicates retail appetite has shifted decisively into greed territory, while BTC dominance holding steady at 58% shows large-cap conviction rather than a speculative rush into smaller coins. Volume near $118B supports these moves as more than sentiment alone.
